schema.description:
Lifecycle state of a hint. `Active` moves to exactly one terminal state:
`Consumed` (a candidate was claimed by the hinted station), `Expired`
(`expiresAt` passed) or `Superseded` (a newer completion at the station
issued a newer hint, or cleared it).
schema.title: HintState
